TV address: %1$s:%2$d

Receiving is enabled for 5 minutes and accepts one APK. In MoonCast on your phone, choose Send APK and this TV. No pairing code or binding is needed.

Only enable this on a trusted home LAN: anyone on the same network can send an APK while this screen is open. Transfer is not encrypted. You must review the APK here before opening Android installer. APKs may be harmful. No .apks / .xapk bundles, URL downloads, or automatic installs. Opening Android settings or installer stops playback.

These are file and certificate details, not a security scan or a trusted-publisher guarantee. Only install apps you trust. Android makes the final compatibility and installation checks.

Use the remote to accept this APK and open Android installer. Opening the installer stops playback.

Allow this install source?

Android requires you to allow MoonCast to request app installs. Open system settings and make that choice yourself. Return here, review the APK again, then select install. Nothing is installed automatically.
Open Android settings
This TV does not provide the install-source settings screen. Installation is unavailable until you enable it yourself in system settings.

Android reported installation completed. The temporary APK has been removed.

Android installer closed without reporting success. Installation may have been canceled or rejected by Android, for example because of an incompatible signature, version or CPU architecture. Check the system message. The temporary APK has been removed.
Network changed. Receiving is disabled. Reopen this screen to enable receiving again.
Permission is enabled. Review this file and press install to continue.
Install permission was not enabled. Nothing was installed. You can cancel or open Android settings again.

Return from Settings to continue

After choosing the install-source permission in Android Settings, return here. Your APK is kept for up to 10 minutes. We will check the permission and file again; installation still needs your next click.
Opening Android installer…
This APK review expired or its temporary file is no longer available. Close this screen, receive the APK again, then review and install it.
